description:
Torch Technologies 
 Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. We are a 100% employee-owned, Certified Great Place To Work and named Best Places to Work in Huntsville/Madison County, headquartered in Huntsville, AL. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!
 
 
 Torch Technologies is seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, test, and maintain modern, secure, and scalable software solutions supporting next-generation defense and enterprise missions. The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering fundamentals, experience developing enterprise applications and API-driven architectures, and the ability to leverage modern technologies, including cloud platforms, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary engineering team to develop innovative solutions that address complex technical and mission requirements.
  
 As a Software Engineer, your duties will include the following, but are not limited to: 
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications and services using C#, .NET 10+, ASP.NET Core, Python, and other modern programming languages and frameworks.
 Develop scalable, maintainable, and high-performance software solutions using object-oriented programming, design patterns, and modern software engineering principles.
 Design, implement, and integrate REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise application interfaces.
 Develop and maintain software components that integrate with relational databases, including SQL Server and PostgreSQL, as well as messaging systems and other data services.
 Design and implement software solutions leveraging cloud technologies, containerization, and distributed computing platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, and AWS.
 Integrate Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI capabilities, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered services into enterprise applications and mission workflows.
 Implement automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), application monitoring, and DevSecOps practices.
 Troubleshoot, debug, optimize, and maintain existing software systems while ensuring reliability, performance, scalability, and security.
 Participate in software design reviews, technical discussions, code reviews, and Agile development activities.
 Collaborate with systems engineers, architects, data engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and other stakeholders to translate technical and mission requirements into effective software solutions.
 Evaluate emerging technologies, development frameworks, and engineering practices to continuously improve software capabilities and development efficiency.
   
 Required Qualifications 
 U.S. Citizenship.
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
 Minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience.
 Active Secret clearance and ability to maintain the clearance.
 Strong programming experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Python, or other modern software development technologies.
 Experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining enterprise software applications.
 Experience developing and integrating REST APIs, working with relational databases, and implementing software integrations.
 Experience with source control systems, software development lifecycle (SDLC), and CI/CD pipelines.
 Knowledge of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, secure coding practices, and software engineering best practices.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile software development environment.
   
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and distributed application architectures.
 Experience developing and deploying applications in Azure, AWS, or government cloud environments.
 Experience with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or Palantir.
 Experience with Python-based development, data engineering, ETL pipelines, and analytics solutions.
 Familiarity with DevSecOps, automated testing frameworks, application security, and defense cybersecurity requirements.
 Experience developing software in classified or air-gapped environments.
 Experience integrating enterprise systems, data platforms, and mission-focused applications.
   
 Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
 Work Location: Onsite – Huntsville, Alabama
 Travel: No
 Relocation Assistance Available: No
 Position Contingent Upon Award of Contract: No

 Benefits:  
  
 Torch Technologies is proud to offer a stable and professional work environment, a competitive salary, and an excellent, comprehensive benefit package including: ESOP participation, 401(k) match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, Health Saving Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts, EAP, education assistance, paid time off, and holidays.  
  
  
 Applying to Torch Technologies:  
  
 Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at Torch Technologies is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check. 
 ­
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, citizenship, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.  Torch Technologies, Inc. participates in E-Verify. 
  
  
 If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Careers Link as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to HR@torchtechnologies.com. Thank you for your interest in Torch Technologies.
